required_package: Exact SUT/board revision, AST2600/BMC and SPI0/CS0 flash identity/layout
Debug and normal jumper reference designator, pin positions, de-energization/AC sequence and photos or fixture record
Trusted `uart_fw_py.exe` version/hash/source and supported host/runtime/driver requirements
Approved `encrypted_rom.ima` version, length, signature/hash, encryption/key compatibility and board mapping
UART wiring/voltage/ground, host COM port mapping and approved 921600 baud setting
Full backup, golden/external programming recovery, stable-power window, timeout and expected final firmware/bank/configuration/health oracle

safety_gate: Remove AC and verify the board is de-energized before moving either jumper; never change a strap live unless an explicit vendor procedure authorizes it
Verify board, image signature/hash/compatibility, trusted utility hash/version, SPI target and UART electrical level before programming

Capture terminal tool completion and verification, then remove AC and restore the exact production jumper position before normal boot
Do not expose BMC passwords through command arguments or logs; use the approved secure credential mechanism
Stop on jumper/target/image/tool/port mismatch, transport/write/verify error, timeout, unexpected current/power event, failed strap restoration, firmware mismatch or loss of BMC access
